subject: Re: Evaluation close cadence — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention questions
messages:
From: Tom Armitage <tom.armitage@crestbank.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: paula.hernandez@crestbank.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Security gating and DPA timing for Redwood eval

Kimberly —

Thanks for the demo last week. As we start lining up the internal approval chain, two items bubbled up from Legal & InfoSec that we need to lock into the MAP so we can reach a close on our procurement timeline:

- SOC 2: we need either the full Type II report or a scoped summary and attestation that covers the data flows for inference (inbound prompt data, ephemeral KV caches, embeddings service).
- SIG/CAIQ: an initial questionnaire or interim responses so our InfoSec team can validate residual risk.
- DPA: CrestBank will circulate redlines; we need your estimated turnaround for a reviewed DPA (we typically need countersigned within 10 business days once redlines acknowledged).
- Data retention / residency: they want explicit retention windows for embeddings, logs, and backups (examples: 30d/90d/365d) and whether logs can be stored in-region (US-East).

Can you confirm what you can provide and a recommended schedule for those deliverables inside the MAP? We’re targeting an internal procurement approval on July 10th, so anything that helps speed the legal review is appreciated.

—Tom
Information Security, CrestBank
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Armitage <tom.armitage@crestbank.com>
Cc: Paula Hernandez <paula.hernandez@crestbank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security gating and DPA timing for Redwood eval

Tom — thanks, and really glad CrestBank found the demo useful. Below is a proposed MAP fragment focused only on security/compliance gating so legal and InfoSec can slot dates into your procurement timeline.

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP excerpt — security deliverables)
Also attached: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2024.pdf (summary + point-of-contact), SIG_CAIQ_interim_responses.xlsx (worksheet with answers we can iterate on).

High level deliverables & suggested schedule (we can compress these if you need faster turnaround):
1) Day 0 (today): Redwood to share MAP excerpt + SOC 2 summary + CAIQ interim responses — DONE (see attachments).
2) Day 2–3: CrestBank to confirm any additional SOC 2 scoping questions and priority CAIQ controls (we’ll highlight the 12–15 most material controls for inference workloads).
3) Day 4–8: Redwood to return completed CAIQ rows + clarifying notes; Legal to raise DPA redline formally.
4) Day 9–15: Redwood responses to DPA redlines and final internal legal review cycle. If CrestBank needs countersigned DPA within 10 business days, we’ll prioritize a rapid review path.

Data retention & residency options (we’ll codify the chosen option in the MAP and DPA):
- Embeddings: default 30 days (hot cache), optional 90 days (archival) — can be configured per-workload.
- Inference logs (non-PII): default 90 days; can be reduced to 30 days for stricter profiles.
- User-provided files / uploads: 365 days unless customer requests shorter retention or on-prem deployment.
- Region: US-East by default for hosted; dedicated/private deployments can be pinned to customer VPC region (US-East or EU-West).

If CrestBank prefers a single retention window across all artifacts for procurement simplicity we can propose a 90-day default with a contractual carveout in the DPA for regulated workflows.

Next steps I suggest:
- You share the DPA redline today (Paula / Legal).
- We schedule a 30-min runthrough with InfoSec (Jordan & Naomi + your InfoSec lead) to walk CAIQ answers and confirm scoping.

I’ll also open a short internal playbook: Jordan, can you own the InfoSec runthrough and make sure the CAIQ XLS has the highlighted control set? Naomi — please prepare the SOC 2 scoping bullets (what is covered and what is out-of-scope).

Thanks — happy to compress timelines if your approval target is July 10th.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

- Review key CAIQ controls and where we’ve provided compensating controls (10m)

Thanks all — quick update after internal sync:

- We received your DPA redline (DPA_Redline_CrestBank.docx) at 10:03 PT. Naomi and I reviewed the high-priority items; Jordan will cover CAIQ specifics on the call tomorrow.
- Proposed fast path to meet July 10th procurement:
  * June 26–27: Redwood finalizes CAIQ responses and returns annotated SOC 2 scoping list (we’ll mark any items that need engineering follow-up).
  * June 30: Redwood provides DPA counterproposal focused on retention/residency & breach notification timelines.
  * July 2–6: Legal cycles and final signoff (we’ll be responsive to comments within 24 business hours during that window).

We’ll stage a signed DPA + MAP at close; if CrestBank needs an interim assurance we can provide a scoped SOC 2 attestation and a notarized letter summarizing retention guarantees for the pilot period.

I’ve uploaded the MAP excerpt and a proposed DPA counter to the DocuSign link (see related links) to make review/countersigning faster. If you’d prefer a redline in Word, we have that ready as well.

Jordan — pls confirm you’re good to run the InfoSec call at 10:30 PT tomorrow.

Kimberly
Senior Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
